summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the Dark and Darker mobile loadout builder (Expo/React Native). All critical flows pass: class selection (9 classes), builder navigation, gear slot rendering (14 slots), stats panel with derived stats, item picker with all 7 rarity tiers, live stat updates on equip, long-press to clear, unequip-slot button, class switcher with item stripping for disallowed classes, AsyncStorage save & load, loadout card restoration, and clear-all gear. No critical bugs found.

issues: Rarity filter ScrollView is horizontal — on a 390px viewport some right-side chips (legendary/unique) require horizontal scrolling to reveal. Real touch users will swipe so this is acceptable, but consider making chips wrap or shrink to fit.
Console warnings: deprecated 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props (react-native-web). Non-blocking but should be migrated to 'boxShadow'/'textShadow' shorthand props.

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace deprecated shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius and textShadow* props with the new boxShadow/textShadow shorthand to silence react-native-web warnings.
(Optional polish) Make rarity-filter chips wrap or compact so all 8 chips fit without horizontal scroll on a 390px-wide viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: Stat math verified end-to-end: Fighter base STR=15, equipping Legendary Plate Cuirass raises STR→21, Armor Rating 30→132, Max HP 213→267. Equipping Legendary Longsword raises Weapon Damage 0→83, STR→21. Class change strips items not allowed (cleric→wizard removes plate-class gear and morning star).
AsyncStorage persistence verified: saved loadout (class+equipment) survives a navigation cycle (builder→home→loadouts→builder) with full restoration.
Item filtering by slot+class works correctly: wizard-only items don't appear for fighters and vice versa.

All required testIDs are present and resolvable: class-card-*, gear-slot-*, rarity-chip-*, item-pick-*, stat-row-*, save-btn, save-dialog, loadout-name-input, save-confirm, class-chip, class-switch-*, clear-all-btn, picker-unequip, picker-close, open-loadouts-btn, loadout-card-*, loadout-delete-*, back-btn, loadouts-back.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 16 features listed in the review request

seed_data_creation: Created and then opened a TEST_ClericPaladin loadout (Cleric class with Chainmail RARE + Morning Star EPIC) to verify save & load flow. AsyncStorage was cleared at the start of the load/save test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is offline-only frontend. Use mobile viewport 390x844. To click rarity-filter chips beyond uncommon, scroll the chip row horizontally first (or scrollIntoView via JS). Alert.alert renders as window.alert/confirm in web — register page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) before save/delete flows. localStorage.clear() resets AsyncStorage between test runs.
rca_of_issue: No issues to RCA. Verified flows: (1) Class selection renders 9 cards via CLASSES array. (2) Builder stats useMemo recomputes via deriveStats whenever equipped map changes — confirmed live updates. (3) Class change effect filters equipped by item.classes membership — confirmed plate dropped on switch to wizard. (4) saveLoadout/loadAllLoadouts use AsyncStorage with key '@dnd_loadouts_v1' and replace-or-append by id — confirmed persistence and re-open with class+gear intact.
